exposure: Neonates exposed to tobacco during pregnancy
Neonates not exposed to tobacco during pregnancy
outcome: Clot amplitude at 10 and 30 min (A10, A30)
Lysis index at 30 and 60 min (LI30, LI60)
cohort: The study included 92 healthy, full-term neonates born at the maternity department of the hospital over a 5-year period.
finding: Neonates exposed to tobacco during pregnancy had shorter clotting times and faster clot formation, indicating a hypercoagulable profile.
